page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Above the text: a woodcut ornament, then a large centred title block (roman capitals, then an italic subtitle). Below: a paragraph opened by a woodcut initial, with one marginal note on the right. No running head.

main_text.l: mum est, quod priori ad Ti-
lus Paulus, {a}diserte dicit, fore vt posterioribus

l.i: temporibus deficiant quidam à fide, Spiritibus

main_text.l: satis superque docet, nimium multos esse,
bus, ab Euangelica veritate, quam antea præ
se ferebant deficientes, Iesuitis ac Capucinis,

page.notes: The marginal reference on the right is printed as "1.Tim.4." with "1." on the line below; transcribed as one note.
